description: Python code for processing PDFs, generating embeddings with Google PaLM, and performing question-answering using langchain. Contains code for reading PDFs, text splitting, embedding generation, and policy explanation.

methods.name: split_text
methods.description: Splits raw text into chunks of specified size with overlap, using CharacterTextSplitter.

methods.name: similarity_search
methods.description: Performs similarity search on the document search index with a query.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the question-answering chain with input documents and question.
